[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Jannet Glasgow was born or baptised at Kilwinning on 1 February 1689. The indexed entry names her father as John Glasgow and gives her mother's surname as Allason.<ref>“Old Parish Registers, Births and Baptisms,” Scotland's People index entry, JANNET GLASGOW, 1 February 1689, parents JOHN GLASGOW / ALLASON, Kilwinning parish 599, frame 75.</ref>

Her father link is retained as the uncertain [[Glasgow-3375|John Glasgow]], not [[Glasgow-1073|Rev. John Glasgow M.A.]]. The two adult profiles must remain separate unless the full parish entry or another record identifies the Kilwinning father. Her mother is represented by [[Allison-6866|Barbara Allison]].
